correctness.rationale: For F_lambda=sum x_i^4+lambda prod x_i, direct differentiation establishes D_p^3F=6L and the first polar C. At lambda=0, L|C iff p has one supported coordinate or two with ratio r^8=1, hence 52 points. In chart p=(1,r,s,t), three pure-cube coefficients of L0^3 C|_{L=0} have Jacobian diag(256(1-9r^8),256,256) at any two-supported Fermat incidence point and diag(256,256,256) at an axis. Thus their formal solution near each is the constant section; along it the complete remainder is 64[4(r-r^9)x1^3+lambda(1-r^4)x1x2x3], yielding local rings C[[lambda]] for r^4=1 and C[[lambda]]/(lambda) for r^4=-1 or r=0. Properness permits shrinking to an algebraic open W containing zero and removes other components; Miura--Taki Proposition 3.5 then gives the precise exterior quasi-Galois count.
